newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Fire damages Reuter's office in Sao Paulo.
newsitem.headline: Fire damages Reuter's office in Sao Paulo.

text.p: A fire destroyed the editorial and financial departments of the Reuters office in Sao Paulo on Monday, temporarily disrupting operations.

Police said the fire, which was first discovered at 6 a.m. local time (0900 GMT), was probably caused by a short circuit in the building air conditioning system, and quickly spread through the office.
Firefighters arrived shortly afterward and had the blaze under control within an hour. No one was in the office when the fire began and there were no injuries, officials said.
The Reuters technical department and dataroom, where communications systems are housed, was largely undamaged, a Reuters spokesman said.
Technical staff said 90 percent of systems were back and functioning by Monday afternoon and all departments and services, including editorial, would be functioning normally by Tuesday morning.
